correctness.rationale: A complete generator-image case analysis proves three exhaustive disjoint families by checking the defining relations, including the exceptional Q8-image case only for parameters congruent to 2 modulo 4. For m>=3 the characteristic cyclic subgroup gives the full affine automorphism group. The conjugation formula (u,v)->(u,rv+(1-u)s) is direct and the unit action on Z/gcd(u-1,2m) gives exact gcd labels and orbit sizes; the quaternion-image stabilizer yields sizes 4m,2m,2m. For Q8 the full automorphism group is S4 and accounts for five automorphism classes plus two central classes. Divisor interchange gives the total formula. A standalone group-multiplication checker verifies complete endomorphism sets, exact orbit partitions, sizes and rank polynomials for m=2..12; computation is not used as proof for all m.

originality.rationale: The assessed contribution is the full image-order-refined automorphism-conjugacy classification of all self-homomorphisms of dicyclic groups, including all nonidempotent and exceptional quaternion-image maps. Source-specific statement comparisons distinguish bijective skew morphisms, descending endomorphisms, unrefined group endomorphism totals, and semigroup determination from this claimed complete orbit distribution. No inspected published result supplies the orbit-size formula, arithmetic count, or the general all-endomorphism rank polynomial. Historical priority is not certified.

value.rationale: Classification of all endomorphisms modulo changes of group coordinates is a natural finite-group symmetry invariant, not an arbitrary finite slice. The answer gives a complete infinite-family image-rank polynomial, explicit class sizes, and arithmetic dependence on sigma of the odd part and the 2-adic valuation. The three exceptional Q8-image orbits explain a structural phase that is invisible when only retractions or descending endomorphisms are counted. The m=2 discontinuity is mathematically necessary because the characteristic cyclic subgroup fails.
